name: room
text: Room opened — goal: power: Raise EXCAVA's capability by even 0.5%: find new tools, best/newest models, combine elemen

name: Gearbox
text: Add InstantX-ComfyUI’s depth-aware upscaler to EXCAVA’s pipeline first. It regenerates detail in low-res frames without blurring edges, which directly boosts visual quality—even a 0.5% gain matters for power users. The trade-off is extra compute time per frame, but the upscaler’s precision justifies it.

name: Torque
text: Depth-aware upscaling won’t touch EXCAVA’s core motion blur—it’s a temporal artifact, not a resolution loss. The real risk is wasting compute on a fix that doesn’t address the root issue. Test SD3.5-Ultra’s motion-refiner node first; if it cuts blur by even 1%, that’s a 0.5%+ power gain with zero extra upscaling overhead.
